description: This file defines a tool for spawning sessions in a system, supporting different runtimes ('subagent' and 'acp'), with configuration schemas, session management, and registration logic.

methods.name: summarizeError
methods.description: Converts an unknown error object into a string message.

methods.name: resolveTrackedSpawnMode
methods.description: Determines spawn mode ('run' or 'session') based on requested mode and thread request.

methods.name: cleanupUntrackedAcpSession
methods.description: Attempts to delete an ACP session key via gateway call, best-effort cleanup.

methods.name: createSessionsSpawnTool
methods.description: Factory function that creates a tool for spawning sessions with configurable parameters and execution logic.
